title: GRC-ProbNet: Uncertainty-aware Feature Extraction for Cardiovascular Disease Classification
abstract: arXiv:2607.10357v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The automatic detection and classification of cardiovascular disease (CVD) from computed tomography (CT) images plays an important role in clinical practice. Recently, a hybrid pipeline (GRC-Net) for CVD classification was proposed, which leverages a deep-learning-based segmentation and registration method to extract radiomic and geometric features. However, GRC-Net relies on a deterministic segmentation mask, without considering the inherent ambiguity associated with cardiac anatomy. translated_title: GRC-ProbNet：用于心血管疾病分类的不确定性感知特征提取
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.10357v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：从计算机断层扫描（CT）图像中自动检测和分类心血管疾病（CVD）在临床实践中起着重要作用。最近，提出了一种用于CVD分类的混合流程（GRC-Net），该流程利用基于深度学习的分割和配准方法来提取放射组学和几何特征。然而，GRC-Net依赖于确定性的分割掩膜，没有考虑与心脏解剖结构相关的固有模糊性。在本文中，我们提出了GRC-ProbNet，它利用深度集成来为给定输入生成多个分割掩膜。从这些掩膜中，我们提取多个不确定性特征。我们分析了这些不确定性特征与分割误差的相关性，以及它们对下游CVD分类性能的传播影响。我们在公开可用的MM-WHS和ASOCA数据集上的实验表明，不确定性特征与分割误差相关，并能影响分类性能。
tldr: 本文提出GRC-ProbNet，通过深度集成生成多个分割掩膜并提取不确定性特征，以解决CVD分类中心脏解剖模糊性问题，实验表明这些特征与分割误差相关并影响分类性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GRC-ProbNet, which uses deep ensembles to generate multiple segmentation masks and extract uncertainty features, addressing cardiac anatomical ambiguity in CVD classification, with experiments showing these features correlate with segmentation error and affect classification performance.
